description: List every service category Muovi supports in Argentina (electricidad, plomería, pintura, etc.). Each entry has a stable `slug` (used as the `service` parameter on `muovi_search_professionals` and `muovi_create_task_link`), a human-readable `name`, an optional description, and a `requires_matricula` flag indicating whether listed professionals must hold a verified professional license. Call this first when you need to map a user's natural-language request to a Muovi service slug.
name: muovi_list_services
title: List services
